'''Trandosha''', also known as '''Dosha''' or '''Hsskhor''', was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the warlike, [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] species. It was located in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|same star system]] as [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], the home world of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], causing bitter animosity between the two species.

==History==
[[File:Blackscale_Jailer.jpg|thumb|left|A Trandoshan slaver]]
The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] around [[7000 BBY]], but by the time of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], it had not integrated itself into the Republic as thoroughly as other planets. Around the time of the [[Jedi Civil War]], the planet negotiated with the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] to gain [[Slavery/Legends|slaving]] rights to [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], beginning a millennia-long struggle between the Wookiees and the Trandoshans. After the Wookiees' revolted against the corporation, with the assistance of the [[Ebon Hawk]] crew, Czerka was forced to withdraw from Kashyyyk, eventually Trandosha and ultimately from the system altogether.<ref name="KOTORCG">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

In the end of the [[New Sith Wars]], it was the site of the [[Battle of Hsskhor]], where the Trandoshans launched a surprise attack on both the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] when they retreated to their camps to rest.

In [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]], a Wookiee vessel was attacked over a moon of Trandosha, resulting in a Wookiee blockade of Trandosha. Peace talks to resolve the issue were conducted [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] and failed when it was revealed that the Trandoshans were pushing for Senatorial representation with [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] backing.

Due to its position within the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]], Trandosha's only representation in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] was [[Yarua/Legends|Yarua]], a Wookiee. The two species had never seen eye to eye, and their relationship was, at best, lukewarm at the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] due to a number of factors. 

Trandosha remained loyal to the Republic during the Clone Wars, and never seceded to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], however a number of independent [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]]s nevertheless joined the Confederacy, such as pirate bands, slavers, and pro-Trandoshan terrorist groups participated in many Separatist actions, particularly those that took place prior to the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]]. In truth many of these groups had indirect financial backing from Trandosha itself, as the planetary government was only too happy to direct its own attacks upon Wookiees from the shadows.<ref name="TCWCG">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

After [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] initiated a blockade of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], most of the system's commerce began to flow through Trandosha, giving the planet an economical boost. The Trandoshans used the influx of credits to upgrade their cities and technology and to buy new starships and weapons, becoming a significant military power in the galaxy.<ref name="LECG">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
